description: Check whether a HeySale salesperson has actually been installed on its website and is reporting back to HeySale. Uses HeySale's own telemetry, so it works with single-page apps, tag managers and deferred script loading — never scrape the website's HTML to answer this. Give it the salesperson_id and the access_token returned when the salesperson was created.

access_token.description: The private access_token returned by create_website_salesperson. Required to see details while the salesperson is unclaimed. Never share it with anyone else.

api_key.description: Developers only. Not required for setup, and never ask a website owner for one.

name: verify_salesperson_installation

last_seen_at.description: When the script was last seen loading. Null before installation.

next_action.description: Plain-language next step for the caller.

claim_url.description: One-time link the website owner uses to claim the salesperson. Absent once claimed.

manage_url.description: Where the owner manages the salesperson. Present once claimed.

status.description: Whether a HeySale account owns this salesperson yet.
Build state of the salesperson, e.g. analyzing, building, ready, failed.

title: Verify a salesperson's website installation
